text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — eu-west1-gpu pool experiencing sustained backlog and failed scale attempts. queue_size=38,400; avg_token_latency=3.9s; autoscaler_errors detected. Paging primary on-call @alex.

alex: ACK. grabbing metrics and logs now. who's on provider escalation? @nina

nina: i'm online. provider console shows repeated 429 responses during attach attempts; rate-limit windows about 30s long. also seeing provisioning retries piling up.

mira: posting autoscaler event stream: ``[2026-03-16T01:04:21Z] scale_up -> request sent; [2026-03-16T01:04:28Z] provider 429; [2026-03-16T01:04:58Z] scale_up failed: quota_hit_or_rate_limit``. config shows region hard_cap=140.

samir: tys. looks like two compounding issues: (A) regional hard_cap reached, (B) provider-side transient 429s preventing smooth attach. backlog rising -> we hit internal throttles and some requests 5xx. quick mitigations: request temporary hard_cap bump to 200, apply route-level fallbacks for large models, and enable strict per-tier throttling to give enterprise paths priority.

alex: can we do a quick fallback only for long-gen routes to reduce tokens/sec? prefer fallback over wholesale capacity increase if provider can't attach.

mira: agree. I'll push route change: ``routes/streaming.yaml: long_gen -> fallback_model: redwood/quant-6b-lite``. That reduces average gpu_ms per request ~45%.

jess: ops approval needed for hard_cap. I can greenlight if we also evict noncritical workloads.

ops_bot: ops sign-off requested: `req=cap-bump-6323`. Please acknowledge.

alex: approved pending evictions. nina, can you open a provider support ticket and request expedited attach windows? include our incident id.

nina: filing now. ticket 99281 opened with provider; added notes about burst attach to help prioritize.

mira: executing noncritical eviction: ``kubectl delete job ingest-warmup-eu --ignore-not-found`` and scaling down background batchers: ``PATCH /config/batcher batch_size=6``.

samir: we've toggled per-tier throttles: free & trial routes set to 60% throttle, standard 30%, enterprise 0%. also applied circuit-breaker to noisy routes.

incident-bot: ADMIN action: temporary cap_override applied -> hard_cap=200 (applied by ops_bot req=cap-bump-6323). Auto-revert in 4h.

alex: seeing first attach success at 01:15Z -> +12 GPUs. queue down to 22k. latency down to 2.4s. still intermittent provider 429s but less frequent.

mira: after fallback and throttles, per-GPU load reduced and batcher metrics show ~40% decrease in tokens/sec. customer 5xxs peaked at +12% and are trending down.

jess: drafting customer note: "We experienced degraded performance in EU region between 01:02-01:18 UTC due to capacity exhaustion and provider attach failures. Mitigations completed; detailed postmortem forthcoming." Want to send now to impacted customers?

samir: hold 10. confirm queue < 5k before broad notice. but send targeted messages to customers already in support tickets.

alex: agreed. nina, update provider ticket asking for post-incident context on 429s so we can include root cause.

nina: done. provider acknowledged a control-plane throttling event affecting several customers in eu-west1 between 01:03-01:12Z. they've assigned an internal RCA.

mira: timeline so far: 01:02Z queue surge -> 01:04Z autoscaler hit hard_cap & provider 429s -> 01:08Z evictions and throttles applied -> 01:10Z fallback pushed -> 01:15Z first attaches succeed -> 01:18Z queue under 5k and system stable.

jess: handing off to night on-call @jess (staying on) and assigning postmortem owners: RCA (mira), autoscaler alerting gaps (samir), provider coordination + ticket follow-up (nina), runbook updates + customer comms (jess).

samir: suggested action items: 1) add early-warning metric for provider attach 429 rate and elevated attach latency; 2) allow autoscaler to surface near-cap alerts (currently only errors); 3) add automated warmers to request spare capacity proactively when predicted queue growth exceeds threshold; 4) refine per-tier throttles to be more granular.

alex: also add safe-guard for burst overrides: require canary attach validation checks before routing traffic. set owner to platform infra.

incident-bot: Note: ops override cap-bump-6323 will auto-revert at 05:15Z unless extended.

jess: I'll open the postmortem doc and link back here. Please paste exact config diffs.

mira: diffs: ``config/autoscaler.yaml hard_cap: 140 -> 200 (override cap-bump-6323), routes/streaming.yaml add fallback redwood/quant-6b-lite, config/batchers.yaml batch_size: 16 -> 6``

nina: provider ticket 99281 updated with incident timeline and request for root cause details.

jess: postmortem checklist for doc: timeline, impact (customers & percentage), root cause hypothesis, mitigations during incident, permanent fixes, owner assignments, rollout plan for fixes, customer comms draft. I'll circulate in 1h. leaving channel but monitoring. :white_check_mark:
